newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki Heavy 96/97 profit seen up - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki Heavy 96/97 profit seen up - paper.

text.p: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd is expected to post a record parent current profit of 35 billion yen in the year to next March 31, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.
Kawasaki Heavy's actual parent current profit in 1995/96 was 27.04 billion yen. The company earlier this year said it expected 1996/97 parent current profit of 32 billion yen.

Economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said its estimate reflected the yen's weaker trend and improved earnings in the company's shipbuilding division. A Kawasaki spokesman was not immediately available for comment on the report.
